# OpenSRM Service Reliability Manifest
# Migrated from legacy NthLayer format
# Original file: checkout-service.yaml
#
# For more information, see:
# https://github.com/rsionnach/opensrm
#

apiVersion: srm/v1
kind: ServiceReliabilityManifest
metadata:
  name: checkout-service
  team: commerce
  tier: critical
  description: Order checkout and payment processing service
spec:
  type: api
  slos:
    availability:
      type: availability
      target: 99.95
      window: 30d
    latency-p95:
      type: latency
      target: 99.0
      window: 30d
    latency-p99:
      type: latency
      target: 95.0
      window: 30d
  dependencies:
  - name: checkout_db
    type: database
    critical: false
  - name: checkout_cache
    type: database
    critical: false
  ownership:
    team: commerce
